input.rationale: There is an express conformance warranty with adequate remedies (correction, replacement, termination and refund) and a no-malicious-code warranty, but the Warranty Period is only 60 days and runs from the Effective Date with a hard December 31, 1999 cut-off — below our fallback of 90 days from delivery and effectively expiring before the five-year hosted deployment matures. input.rationale: There is no insurance clause anywhere in the Agreement or its Exhibits, yet Commerce One's operations, consulting and engineering personnel work with our hosted environment and its MarketSite.net Service handles our Customers' transaction data.
